why: A candidate is a claim that something should change. harness2's rule, kept here in stdlib form: a claim about behaviour is only evidence if something was executed and its output was looked at. This file is the contract; scripts/candidate_check.py is the enforcer. Nothing here is decorative -- every key is read by the script.

means.invariant: the candidate would change the measuring apparatus (rules/, scripts/, tests/, this file). The bar is a real run, always.
means.domain: the candidate would change content (the vault, notes, docs). A run is required when the claim is about behaviour.

cue.means: the situation the lesson applies to, in one line. NO_ENTRY is a legal value: it says honestly that nothing in memory applied, which is data, not a gap.

lesson.means: what to do next time, phrased so a different agent could follow it.

evidence.means: paths, URLs or probe ids that a reader can open. An evidence line that points at nothing is a fabrication.

confidence.means: how much this lesson is trusted. It is not a decoration: below the floor the candidate cannot be promoted on its own.

means.proposed: the loop raised this and nothing has been measured yet. Legal on the shelf, never promotable: a proposal is a to-do, not a claim about behaviour.
means.helped: measured better after the change -- needs a fresh pass probe
means.hurt: measured worse -- needs a fresh failing probe
means.no_observed_effect: changed, measured, nothing moved -- needs a probe record
means.confounded: the measurement cannot be trusted -- needs evidence explaining why, and cannot be promoted alone
means.keep_base: the honest answer is to change nothing. This is an output, not a failure, and needs no probe.

no_entry.forbids: claiming a lesson at the same time: a NO_ENTRY row that also teaches something is not a NO_ENTRY

probe_required_when.except: verdict proposed: the loop may name an apparatus change it has not measured, because naming it is the point of the cycle. Nothing unmeasured leaves the shelf -- see promote_floor.
probe_required_when.freshness: a probe record for this candidate id whose fingerprint_at and fingerprint_after both equal the current state fingerprint -- an old measurement describes a tree that no longer exists

promote_floor.confounded: never promotable alone: the disagreement must be recorded, not resolved by deleting one side
promote_floor.proposed: never promotable: run scripts/probe.py, then set a verdict the measurement supports
promote_floor.probe: must exist, be fresh and match the verdict before the candidate leaves the shelf

count_identity.rule: proposed == adopt + revise + drop + keep_base + open
count_identity.means: every candidate the loop raised is written to 14_CANDIDATES/loop/ledger.jsonl the moment it is proposed and gets a disposition the moment a human decides. A row that vanishes without one is a lost measurement, so the ledger and the shelf are reconciled by scripts/candidate_check.py on every health run.
count_identity.labels: disposition labels are unique per row -- a second label for the same id means two things were conflated
